notes: New to Crisp? When the editor is empty it now offers “Try it on a sample clip”: one click restores a short clip that ships inside the app, reduced on purpose to old camera-phone quality, and opens the before and after — all on your Mac, nothing uploaded. Asking Crisp to colourise black-and-white footage now gets a plain answer: it can’t, and it says what it can do instead — restore it, upscale it or give it a sepia tone. “Black and white to colour” no longer turns a clip black and white.
